crossRefs.note: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It…
that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you…
“All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
“ ‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to Yahweh as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a…
If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part…
Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours.…
You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels…
You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your…
This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of…
Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

translations.web: also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
translations.bsb: And we will bring the firstborn of our sons and our livestock, as it is written in the Law, and will bring the firstborn of our herds and flocks to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God.
translations.kjv: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
translations.asv: also the first-born of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God;
